newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela's CANTV expects 12.5 pct dividend payout.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's CANTV expects 12.5 pct dividend payout.

text.p: Venezuela's telehone company CANTV said on Friday it expects to pay out a dividend of 12.5 percent from cash collectable earnings in 1998.

"We expect to pay out a dividend in 1998 based on our results from 1997," the company's chief financial officer Andres Glusky told a roadshow for the $1.0 billion domestic and international share offering of the firm later this month.
"We would have a minimum payout ratio of 12.5 percent in cash."
The Venezuelan government is selling most of its remaining 49 percent stake in the firm, though it will retain a 7.5 percent share, the company said.
It is making a domestic tranche available as well as offering American depositary shares with a New York listing to European and U.S. investors.

The share price has been set an an indicated range of $3.07 to $3.50 and each ADS will represent seven D class shares. The issue will be priced on November 21. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
